stories.title: Rates are exerting a tightening impulse but credit and volatility show little canonical transmission
stories.whatChanged: Front-end yields and real yields are elevated while canonical IG/HY OAS have moved only a few basis points over the past 20 sessions.
stories.whyItMatters: If tightening stays concentrated in rates, growth-sensitive sectors (semis, small caps) can weaken without broad credit or volatility stress.
stories.mechanism: Higher policy path and real yields raise discount rates and funding costs; dealers/auction demand may be absorbing supply so credit spreads and volatility remain contained.
stories.conclusion: Rates are tightening conditions, but canonical evidence of transmission into credit and volatility is not present.
stories.whatWouldChangeMind: A canonical MOVE/VIX series rise and persistent IG/HY OAS widening or repeated auction tails would confirm transmission.

stories.title: AI/semiconductor leadership is narrowing while some hyperscalers show capex pressure
stories.whatChanged: AI/infra breadth is weak versus strong large-cap breadth; AMZN shows deeply negative simple cash FCF for Q3 2026 derived from SEC filings.
stories.whyItMatters: Narrow leadership raises downside risk if rates or funding pressure forces capex moderation or order delays in the AI supply chain.
stories.mechanism: Front-loaded AI capex raises cash PP&E; if revenue or external financing weakens, issuers may trim future capex, which would hit suppliers and semiconductors.
stories.conclusion: AI/semiconductor leadership is narrowing and AMZN's derived simple cash FCF is deeply negative; whether this forces capex cuts is unresolved.
stories.whatWouldChangeMind: Issuer-confirmed guidance to trim capex or supplier order cancellations would confirm capex rephasing.

stories.title: SEC regulatory adoption of Treasury clearing rules is confirmed (context only)
stories.whatChanged: Packet contains a canonical record that the SEC adopted the Treasury clearing rules in December 2023.
stories.whyItMatters: Regulatory design can affect dealer behaviour and long-run market structure for Treasury clearing and funding costs.
stories.mechanism: An adopted rule alters legal/clearing framework; whether it changes short-run dealer balance-sheet behaviour requires market-evidence linkage.
stories.conclusion: Adoption is confirmed by an official canonical record; no canonical market impact is established in this packet.
stories.whatWouldChangeMind: Direct market evidence tying dealer balance‑sheet shifts or auction impairment to the rule would make it decision‑relevant.

investigations.question: Is recent yield repricing transmitting into IG credit, volatility and broader market stress beyond HY?
investigations.whyItMatters: Transmission would convert a rates impulse into broader financing stress and weaken risk assets beyond narrow leaders.
investigations.currentExplanation: Front-end and real yields are elevated and ACM term‑premium ticked up, but canonical IG/HY OAS moves are small and no canonical MOVE/VIX series is present; breadth is mixed (large-cap healthy, AI breadth weak).
investigations.expectedReaction: Conventional: rising real yields/front end should widen credit spreads, lift VIX and weaken broad breadth/small caps.
investigations.observedReaction: Yields high (10Y 4.94%; 2Y 4.56%); IG/HY OAS changed only a few bps; large-cap breadth strong while AI/semis breadth and SMH underperformance vs QQQ are notable; canonical volatility monitor absent.
competingExplanations: Rates repricing is concentrated and has not reached credit.
Dealer funding and auction demand are absorbing supply, delaying spread widening.

candidateExplanations.explanation: Concentrated rates sensitivity without broad credit stress.
candidateExplanations.discriminatingTest: Canonical MOVE/VIX uptick and persistent IG OAS widening over next 20 sessions.

candidateExplanations.explanation: Dealer/auction demand is temporarily absorbing selling, delaying spread widening.
candidateExplanations.discriminatingTest: Evidence of repeated auction tails or primary dealer share increases alongside widening OAS.

investigations.researchNext: Ingest canonical MOVE and VIX series; monitor IG/HY OAS persistence; watch next three Treasury auctions for tails and dealer participation. Confirm global duration with Bund, gilt and JGB long ends; cross-check gold versus real yields and USD; review available credit and breadth as context
investigations.confirmationCondition: Canonical MOVE/VIX rise plus multi-session IG/HY widening.
investigations.invalidationCondition: MOVE/VIX remain flat and IG/HY OAS stay near current levels over next 20 sessions.

verified.detail: Citadel Securities' historical midterm-year path shows equities tending to weaken into around September 30 before a stronger average year-end phase; this supports late-September seasonality as context, not a forecast.
